answer.rationale: With the contract expiring in 14 days and the line at 94% committed volume with no buffer, an immediate primary-vendor switch could create unacceptable delivery and migration risk. I would verify the incumbent’s demonstrated continuity and the low-cost vendor’s onboarding and supply performance before committing. Renewal is the current intent, despite the savings mandate, because continuity risk may outweigh unit-price savings in total cost of ownership.
